text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from my outing with No 
Reason. Once I got back to my room, I had 
to prepare "those materials"— Thinking 
about it made my steps feel a little 
heavy.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, what's the matter~? You look 
awfully glum for someone who just went 
out."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
A speech battle at the Trainer Recruitment 
Lecture, you say? Oh! I actually know this 
opponent as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"My opponent is from a prestigious family 
with a flawless track record. To have a 
speech duel on the same stage with them—"
choice_data_list:
To be honest... I'm hesitating on whether 
to participate.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: —...Umu! Then follow me.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It is a VR game I have been hooked on 
lately! You see, it is set in the Sengoku 
period!

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Apprentice
text_block_list.text:
"I am still an 'Apprentice,' but they say 
as I defeat enemies, I can steadily rise 
through the ranks!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Apprentice
text_block_list.text: First—I shall provide an example!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, No Reason dashed off. Ahead 
of her stood an NPC over three meters 
tall!
choice_data_list: What!? Can we beat something that huge!?

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Apprentice
text_block_list.text:
Wherever there is a battlefield, No Reason 
is there! For I am—a hero worth a thousand 
warriors!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: No Reason leaped up vigorously—

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Apprentice
text_block_list.text: I lost, I tell thee—!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Apprentice
text_block_list.text:
"Yet I've seen through your sword's path! 
This time for sure—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The enemy NPC raises its blade toward No 
Reason!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Apprentice
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, as expected, taking another big 
swing! If I knew that's what was coming, 
something like this—

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Apprentice
text_block_list.text: I lost, I tell thee—!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Apprentice
text_block_list.text:
Grrr... Even if I see it coming, my body 
can't keep up! What to do about this, 
hm...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The difference in physique from the enemy 
NPC was obvious. Both its power and speed 
were on a completely different level.
choice_data_list:
The gap is just too big, maybe it can't be 
helped...

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Apprentice
text_block_list.text: Whaaaat in the world are you saying?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Apprentice
text_block_list.text:
The weak overcoming the strong! That is 
the true thrill of the Sengoku era!

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Apprentice
text_block_list.text:
No matter how big the gap in skill is, I 
will never give up!

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Apprentice
text_block_list.text:
I can follow the blade with my eyes— I've 
already figured out the attack patterns, 
too! Now if only my body would...

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Apprentice
text_block_list.text: Mmh... My body... can't keep up...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Apprentice
text_block_list.text:
—Kh! ...That is it! We have that, do we 
not!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Apprentice
text_block_list.text: I have a special method!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having left those parting words, No Reason 
hurried away from the scene—

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Apprentice
text_block_list.text: "Wahahaha!! Light as a feather!!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Apprentice
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, defense is practically zero! 
Thus, if an enemy attack lands, 'tis 
likely a one-hit KO. However, that is what 
it truly means to aim for victory!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Apprentice
text_block_list.text:
The plans are laid— all that's left is for 
me to believe in myself!

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Apprentice
text_block_list.text:
Now! Next time, I shall finish it without 
fail!

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Apprentice
text_block_list.text:
Time and time again I fought... and was 
defeated! Yet all of that became my 
nourishment!

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Apprentice
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha!! You can't hit me, can't hit 
me-!! I've already seen through your sword 
strokes!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason: Apprentice
text_block_list.text: Now—the overthrow begins!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason's blade—finally struck down the 
enemy general.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
See there! Difference in height or skill 
matters not. If you believe you will not 
lose, you shall not lose.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe she actually won. Even 
with a gap like that—
choice_data_list:
I won't give up... So this is what a 
giant-killing upset feels like

There really are countless ways to race, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! This is true climbing of the 
ranks! A true revolution from below~!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Nyahaha~! Right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "VR Sengoku Game". I thought I'd try 
playing it alone this time.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I have charged across countless 
battlefields. That is precisely why――I 
will not let this chance for victory slip 
away.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...And there! Nyahaha~! Did I look totally 
cool or what?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, No Reason's smile looked 
brighter than usual today.
